requirements.label: Deliverables
requirements.means: Target 50–60 sec sweet spot. One creative cut, no carousel.

requirements.label: Required Length
requirements.means: Hard target 55s. Hook by 0:02. CTA by 0:50.

requirements.label: Format
requirements.means: Phone vertical. Talking-head primary, light B-roll + screen demo overlay.

requirements.label: Theme
requirements.means: Story = interview-brain freeze. Tie marketing-ops background as credibility, not lead.

requirements.label: Tone
requirements.means: Julz Tier-2 ON. 'Smart friend' energy. Dry humor. No 'Hi guys'.

requirements.label: Required Messaging
requirements.detail: Natural mention of ParakeetAI as real-time AI interview assistant
requirements.means: Name the product once mid-body. Demo or screen-show during B-roll. No 'cheating' framing.

requirements.label: Product Mention/Demo
requirements.detail: Screen demo or mention of live AI answers during interview
requirements.means: Cut to brief phone-screen overlay (Parakeet panel during a mock interview).

requirements.label: Posting Requirements
requirements.detail: Likely TikTok / Reels / Shorts — creator handle
requirements.means: Post on @geezjulz TikTok primary. Cross-post Reels. Tag @parakeetai.

requirements.label: Usage Rights
requirements.detail: Paid usage rights — uncapped bonus tier
requirements.means: ParakeetAI can repurpose for paid ads. Track via Content Rights Ledger.

requirements.label: Payment
requirements.detail: $25 base per video + up to $100/100K views bonus
requirements.means: Low base, high upside. Optimize for save-rate + watch-time.

requirements.label: Bonus
requirements.detail: Optional $300 add-on for 5 short paid-ad cuts in week 1
requirements.means: Decline add-on for this batch — focus quality on hero video first.

requirements.label: Deadline
requirements.means: Film May 20. Edit May 21–22. Buffer 4 days for revisions.

requirements.label: Revision Policy
requirements.means: Lock concept BEFORE filming. Send rough cut for sanity check before final color.

requirements.label: Do-Not-Do
requirements.detail: No 'cheating' framing, no 'guaranteed offer' claims, no influencer voice
requirements.means: Position as 'live answer support', not 'fake your way in'. No hardship reveal.

missingInfo.question: Does 'uncapped bonus' track per-platform views or aggregate across TikTok+Reels+Shorts?
Is a screen recording of the actual Parakeet panel required, or is verbal mention enough?
Can I cross-post to LinkedIn for the tech-interview audience, or is TikTok/Reels/Shorts exclusive?

meansSummary.goal: Make a 55-sec talking-head that sells the interview-brain-freeze pain point — and lands ParakeetAI as the natural fix without sounding like an ad.
meansSummary.audience: Software engineers, AI/ML candidates, and adjacent operators actively interviewing — skeptical of obvious AI-promo content.
meansSummary.keyFocus: The 'my brain deletes my career' moment. Marketing-ops credibility layer beneath a software/interview story.
dos: Open on the interview-blank moment, not on the product
Use marketing-ops background as credibility, not lead-with
Show brief screen of Parakeet panel during a mock answer
End with a single clean CTA — link in bio, no hard-sell
donts: No 'cheating the interview' or 'guaranteed offer' framing
No pretending to be a full-stack engineer
